open_points.subject: _canonical_intake_fingerprint / _project_expense_intake
open_points.text: MUST hash the complete canonical intake independent of input/hash order and exclude clock, actor session, and storage path.
open_points.other_text: MUST build the ExpenseIntake from the confirmed publication: recognized_document_id, document_reference, file_ref, document_type, supplier, document_date, currency, total_amount, confirmed_at, contract_version and provenance_ref from the same-named fields of the publication; project_id from the project_id of the authorized context; confirmed_by from the actor_id of that context; and allocations from the allocations argument, the explicit instructions, unchanged. These fields are the intake fingerprint inputs.
open_points.question: Must file_ref, which identifies the storage path, be included in the fingerprint inputs or excluded from the canonical fingerprint?
